availability.note: A block ships only when the feed states its field (depth and direction, rush lane, havoc placement) on at least 80% of the season's plays; below that the arrays are empty and `coverage` says how much there was.

defense_players_definition: Defense side `players`: defenders credited with a play on a pass to this cell -- a break-up, an interception, or the tackle on the reception -- counted in `targets`. Not a coverage assignment.
havoc_placement: Break-up: where the pass was thrown. TFL: the run's lane. Sack, and a hurry with no throw: middle. Forced fumble: its play's lane. Interception: unplaceable (the feed gives a yardline, not a side) -- counted in `unattributed.havoc`.
